meaning: Unique ChEMBL identifier of the compound
project_role: Join key to the other four files; not a feature

meaning: Drug name or development code of the compound
encoding: Upper-case text: drug name or code (e.g. AZD-7624)
project_role: Display label in the application; not a feature

encoding: Whole numbers stored as float: 1, 2, 3 = clinical trial phases, 4 = approved
project_role: Metadata: used to derive the 'approved' flag and to filter / interpret clusters; not a clustering feature

meaning: Year the drug was first approved
encoding: Year stored as float (e.g. 2012.0); empty when the molecule is not approved
Text with 4 categories: Small molecule, Unknown, Antibody, Protein
project_role: Filter: only 'Small molecule' molecules are clustered

meaning: The molecule's structure written as a line of text (SMILES)
encoding: SMILES string; '.' separates fragments (salts, solvents); '@' and '/' encode stereochemistry
project_role: Main input: standardized, then converted to fingerprints and descriptors

meaning: Hashed standard identifier of the structure
encoding: 27-character text: connectivity block - stereo/isotope block - protonation letter
Float, in daltons; the ChEMBL value includes counter-ions
project_role: Clustering descriptor (recomputed on the parent structure)

meaning: Calculated lipophilicity, LogP (fat vs water solubility)
Polar surface area (polar part of the molecule)
project_role: Clustering descriptor, called TPSA in the project (recomputed)
Extra clustering descriptor (not in the project's list of six)

meaning: Number of Lipinski drug-likeness rules broken
project_role: Not used: derived from molecular weight, logP, HBD and HBA, so redundant
